title: The Login Curse
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
audience: Signed clients with no placement (any procrastinator)
activation_barrier: Perceived login / onboarding friction ('placing accounts is a hassle').
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.

engine_mapping.fix: place by email, skip the portal

distribution: Day-7 slot of the client activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette

victor_the_vampire.note: locked canonical Victor; used as image reference on every scene keyframe

models.assembly: ffmpeg in Higgsfield sandbox (normalize 1280x720@30 -> concat -> VO delayed under scene 3)

voiceover.line: Getting your accounts to Southwest Recovery Services is easier than you think. Send your first accounts today.

scenes.visual: Victor at a bright SWRS-branded desk, exasperated by a failed login.
Victor comically poofs into dust; a cartoon bat flutters away. Harmless gag.

scenes.voiceover: Getting your accounts to Southwest Recovery Services is easier than you think. Send your first accounts today.
scenes.visual: Victor reforms, relaxed and smiling, gesturing to a glowing email icon.

notes: Proof of concept: renders on the fast/budget animation model (kling3_0_turbo, 720p). For a polished final, re-run scene animation on a premium model and/or 1080p, and consider baked captions via the caption pipeline.

Final MP4 is hosted on Higgsfield storage (link above); it is not committed as a binary because the session proxy blocks downloading it into the repo. To archive the binary, download from the link and drop it into this folder.
